Without a defined fit the pin may not assemble or locate correctly; the designer should add an appropriate ISO fit or tolerance band to D6.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout (e.g., h6, g6, or a specific tolerance band) to dimension D6."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-(English) 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 specifies hardness (28-32 HRC) but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (e.g., before or after final machining and plating).
